what_this_is: The Workshop rows of tools/network-people: a person's Network profile, the search by meaning, the shared-pursuit path, and the contact released after an introduction. Each row runs one process that reads and writes the network_records rows of the database the caller names through its held connection.

payload.label: Set how people can find me
payload.job: Change how this person shows in the Network: the name, handle, what they offer and seek, whether they are findable, their pursuits and their meaning vectors
payload.description: Saves the person's network_records profile row in the database named (or the held connection named), changing only the fields sent. A field a person wrote is listed under written. A handle is 3 to 30 letters, digits or underscores and is unique among the profiles. A contact is kept on the person's own row and is never answered by the search or path tools; read-a-network-contact answers it only while an introduction is released.

subject.description: The person, the way the Network names them

database.description: The name of the person's pursuit database that holds the network_records table, such as sample_for_who_runs_it. The computer opens it with the login its vault holds as that name and -connection.

credential_name.description: The vault name of the connection, when it is not the database's own name

provenance.source: the old network_profile (an older tag of the old worker tools, tools.mjs.held:295 at a476dd597): the person's own Network profile, shown to other people only when findable

payload.label: Find people in the Network
payload.job: Find people in the Network whose listings are close in meaning to a need, or share its words when there is no meaning vector
payload.description: Answers the findable people, by handle and never by contact, whose listing embedding is at least the Network's min_similarity close to the need's embedding (sent as embedding); with no embedding, a listing answers when it shares a word with the need. A person who labelled the searcher unwanted-requests or unsafe is left out. Reads the network_records rows of the database named.

input.subject: person:sample-bo

payload.label: Who is on my path
payload.job: Show people whose shown pursuits are close in meaning to one of this person's pursuits
payload.description: Answers the people who chose to show their pursuits and whose pursuit is at least on_your_path.min_similarity close, by cosine, to one of this person's pursuits (each pursuit carries its embedding), each with both pursuits beside each other. Open pursuits: spaces you are not in whose join rows let anyone in (a free row) and whose embedding is close to one of your pursuits, at most the settings cap (6).

payload.label: Read a network contact
payload.job: Give a person another person's contact, only once an introduction between them is released
payload.description: Answers the contact of the person named by `of`, to the person named by `subject`, only while an introduction between the two is in a released state: accepted, waiting for AIs, introduced or talked. Proposed, one yes, sent, declined, passed and expired are refused, and so is a stranger.
